ai_positioning.summary: Amphenol Corporation a une exposition significative à l'IA générative via son segment IT Datacom. L'entreprise a enregistré une croissance de 4,6 milliards de dollars dans les applications IA de nouvelle génération, avec une forte demande pour les produits utilisés dans les applications IA générative, les serveurs IA, et les équipements de cloud computing.
evidence: Net sales to the IT datacom market increased approximately $4,593.7, as we experienced robust growth across a broad array of applications, in particular the continued acceleration in and strong demand for products used in next-generation AI-related applications

Net sales in the Communications Solutions segment increased 91% in both U.S. dollars and constant currencies, as well as 71% organically, in 2025, compared to 2024. The sales growth in 2025 was primarily driven by robust organic growth in the IT datacom market, with particular strength in AI-related applications
ai_positioning.source: Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis, Results of Operations section

company_description: Amphenol Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and markets electrical, electronic, and fiber optic connectors in the United States, China, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Communications Solutions, Harsh Environment Solutions, and Interconnect and Sensor Systems. The company offers connectors and connector systems, including high speed, radio frequency, power, fiber optic and other interconnect products; busbars and power distribution systems; power interconnect products; and other products. It also provides value-add products, such as backplane interconnect systems, cable assemblies and harnesses, and cable management products; and other products comprising flexible and rigid printed circuit boards, hinges, other mechanical, and production related products. In addition, the company offers consumer device, network infrastructure, and other antennas; coaxial, power, and specialty cables; and sensors and sensor-based products.
